title: Account Deletion Readback
description: Stops an account deletion that loses more than the user expects or keeps charging them: before Delete it reads back what goes, teams left with no owner (with a transfer button), App Store and Google Play subscriptions that keep billing until cancelled there, the date it can be restored until, what the law keeps and a data export, and unlocks Delete only after a typed confirmation, labelled "Delete without export" until a copy is taken, and lets the user schedule deletion for when a paid period ends instead of losing paid time.
